name: papergrader
description: Visually grade scanned paper tests and produce correction PDFs that print back onto the original student papers.

interface.shortDescription: Grade scanned tests by eye and print corrections onto the originals
interface.longDescription: Personal teaching tool. The assistant visually reads every student answer and records its judgment. Bundled Python handles PDF mechanics and arithmetic only, then produces red correction overlays, a preview, reports and a validation report.
defaultPrompt: Grade these scanned tests with PaperGrader.
